protocol.primary_recovery: Existing Eastward sideways maneuver only; no climb selection

fbs.feature: required clearance minus minimum actual 3D body clearance; EMA through approval inclusive

protocol.readiness: Atomic profiles/plans, full measured warmed computation; startup compile separate; unavailable predictions fail open
protocol.ordering: Approval first; readiness; dispatch; pending timers; maneuver start; physical ticks. Dispatch wins timer ties.
protocol.use_time_recheck: One immediate-command rollout from actual dispatch state; act at dispatch + floor(runtime*50)+1
protocol.unknown_delay: Only the physical driver knows scheduled dispatch. Policies receive the event when it occurs.
protocol.independent_forecasts: One full timed computation per (policy, approval snapshot); no cross-policy result caching
protocol.horizon_rule: First-invalid command/completion cutoff; recovery trigger is the last safe grid point before first recovery failure; all-safe profiles are censored
protocol.late_rule: Only recover proactively within verified recovery prefix unless command safety has expired; expired-command fallback is best-effort
protocol.dispatch_rule: Dispatch wins timer ties. RecoveryAware preserves safety gate; Dual adds completion rejection only while recovery is verified
